title: feat(mcp,service-knowledge): serve search_knowledge on the MCP door, and say when a skill is withheld
body:
Fixes #36650

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:应用装了知识库服务后,用自带 AI 通过 MCP 连接的客户现在能直接检索应用的知识库;绑定知识检索的技能也会出现在提示列表里。
- 为什么做:属于「MCP 问数」主线,解决自带 AI 的客户够不到应用知识库、相关技能被悄悄隐藏的问题。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是 MCP 客户看不到知识检索或技能仍被隐藏,不会读到无权查看的记录或被标为不对 AI 开放的知识源;改动可直接回滚。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

**Item 1: a knowledge family on the MCP door.** `search_knowledge` registers on both MCP transports wherever the kernel holds a `knowledge` service that serves the tool's executor and the grant reaches the read family (`data:read`, or an API key / session with no OAuth grant), like `registerDatasetTools` / `registerPackageDocTools`.

- **One definition + one executor (ADR-0149 D2), homed in `@objectstack/service-knowledge`.** `knowledge-tools.ts` holds the tool's `AIToolDefinition` (`getKnowledgeToolDefinitions`: name, description, JSON Schema of `query` / `sourceIds` / `topK`) and its executor (`createKnowledgeTools`, exposed on the service as `KnowledgeService.knowledgeTools()`, the structural seam the analytics service's `datasetTools` already uses). `packages/mcp` registers the definition as handed over (its JSON Schema through zod's `fromJSONSchema`, the conversion bridged registry tools already take), so the door keeps no copy of the description or the argument shape. The name is the one `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai']` already lists; no second dialect.
- **The caller's execution context (ADR-0090 D10).** `runtime/domains/mcp.ts` resolves the `knowledge` service only under the `data:read` gate (`resolveMcpKnowledgeToolsService`) and binds `searchKnowledge` to `context.executionContext`; the stdio bridge binds it to the principal it resolves per call. The open service then re-checks every object-source hit against that context's row-level security.
- **`aiExposed` enforcement — where it belongs.** Measured on `origin/main` 65ee4b7a: `KnowledgeService.resolveSearchTargets` filters `aiExposed !== false` only when `sourceIds` is empty, so an explicit `sourceIds: ['x']` reaches an `aiExposed: false` source. The enforcement lands in the **tool's executor in `service-knowledge`** (the producer of the one definition every door registers), not in an MCP-side patch and not in `IKnowledgeService.search`: `aiExposed` is defined as "may `search_knowledge` expose this source to agents", and `search()` also serves non-agent platform callers that legitimately name a source explicitly. The executor searches only exposed sources and refuses any other `sourceIds` entry `NOT_FOUND` with the same sentence an unknown id gets, so a withheld source's existence is not disclosed.
- **An empty `sourceIds` is refused (review S1, option a).** The definition declares `minItems: 1` on `sourceIds` and the executor refuses `[]` with `VALIDATION_ERROR`/400 naming the fix (omit it, or name at least one id). Chosen over reading `[]` as "omitted" because the loud contract gives an AI author a refusal it can correct: searching nothing would answer no passage, which the tool's description tells the model to report as "nothing matched". The door's schema is converted from that same definition, so it refuses `[]` before dispatch and agrees with `parseInput`.
- `MCP_DOOR_TOOL_NAMES` (`@objectstack/spec/system`) gains `search_knowledge`; the conformance pin in `mcp-file-tools.test.ts` (wireBridgeTools registers exactly that list) carries the knowledge members.

**Item 2: withholding is no longer silent.**

- **Lint (`ai-skill-tool-unresolved`, warning).** A skill MCP would project as a prompt (`instructions`, `mcpPrompt` not `false`, `active` not `false`) whose `tools` names one of the `ask` product's tools no MCP connection serves (`PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai']` minus `MCP_DOOR_TOOL_NAMES` = `aggregate_data`, `query_data`, `visualize_data`) gets a verdict naming the tool and saying MCP withholds the skill. The `build` product's names are deliberately excluded: a host can serve them over MCP through its authoring family under `metadata:write`. `os explain ai-skill-tool-unresolved` carries a paragraph for it. No new gate.
- **Runtime (debug).** `registerSkillPrompts` takes an optional logger; on the HTTP door each `prompts/list` that withholds a skill logs one `debug` line naming the skill and each bound tool the connection does not serve.

Docs: `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` (tool table + probe comment), `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` (the callouts that said knowledge search is in-product only).

- `@objectstack/mcp` `src/mcp-knowledge-tools.test.ts` (new, 12): registers read-only under the definition's description and closed schema; `data:read` admits it; a grant without `data:read` lists it not and a call never reaches the bridge; a bridge missing either member registers nothing else differently; arguments reach the bridge as sent; an undeclared argument, and an empty `sourceIds`, are refused before the bridge; a bridge refusal comes back as the coded envelope; a skill binding `search_knowledge` is listed in `prompts/list` when served and withheld with exactly one debug line naming skill and tool when not; the stdio bridge carries the members only with the executor and runs each call as the resolved principal.

## Acceptance notes

- **Open-home choice, not a fork.** The in-product `search_knowledge` executor lives in the closed cloud repo, and cloud#4933 records that it is never registered there; this PR does not read that repo (NOT MEASURED). The open definition here is the one ADR-0149 D2 asks for, and cloud#4933 can register `getKnowledgeToolDefinitions()` / `knowledgeTools()` rather than a second shape.
- The withheld-skill verdict covers the `ask` product's tools only. Two classes it does not cover, stated rather than guessed: a skill bound to a `stack.tools` record name (no MCP door serves tool records), and a binding served only when an optional service is mounted (`search_knowledge` with no knowledge service, the dataset pair with no analytics service) — authoring time cannot see what a deployment mounts; the runtime debug line covers those.
- `IKnowledgeService.search` semantics are unchanged (explicit `sourceIds` still reach any registered source for non-agent callers); only the agent tool enforces `aiExposed`.
- The long-lived stdio server registers skill prompts without the binding filter, as before; the withholding and its debug line are the HTTP door's.

## Verification

Read first (by risk): `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-tools.ts` (the `aiExposed` refusal and the context hand-off), `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` (the `data:read` gate and `searchKnowledge` binding `ec`), `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` (`registerKnowledgeTools`).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge exec vitest run src/__tests__/knowledge-tools.test.ts` — expect 16 passed, including `refuses a named aiExposed:false source with the sentence an unknown id gets, and searches nothing`.
